control.description-key: Upload attachments easily using drag and drop

property.name: DefaultNoteTitle
property.description-key: Sets the default title for the Note attachment

property.name: UseNoteAttachment
property.description-key: Upload as attachment on the Notes entity when Email or Appointment instead of Attachment(ActivityMimeAttachment)

property.name: HostMode
property.description-key: Auto detects the host. In a model driven app the control uploads to Dataverse itself; in a canvas app it returns the files through the SelectedFiles output instead.

property.name: ShowSuccessMessage
property.description-key: Show the confirmation message listing how many files were uploaded. Canvas apps only.

property.name: MaxFileSizeKB
property.description-key: Largest accepted file size in KB. Leave empty or 0 for no limit.

property.name: AcceptedFileTypes
property.description-key: Comma separated list of accepted file extensions or mime types, for example .pdf,.docx,image/*. Leave empty to accept everything.

property.name: IsProcessing
property.description-key: Set to true while the app is uploading. Shows the spinner and blocks further drops, the same as during a model driven upload. Canvas apps only.

property.name: ProcessingFileName
property.description-key: Name of the file currently being uploaded, shown next to the spinner while IsProcessing is true. Canvas apps only.

property.name: SelectedFiles
property.description-key: JSON array of the files picked in the last batch. Each entry has name, type, size and content (base64). Canvas apps only.

property.name: SelectedFilesCount
property.description-key: Number of files in the last batch returned through SelectedFiles. Canvas apps only.

property.name: LastBatchId
property.description-key: Increments on every batch, so OnChange still fires when the same files are picked twice in a row. Canvas apps only.
